target_customer: Digital health companies, medical groups and MSOs that bill insurers
problem: Medical billing and claims follow ups were manual and error prone, and legacy RCM vendors served large hospitals. Candid automates the revenue cycle through an API platform.
business_model: B2B software and services with fees on collections or per claim (exact pricing not found)

founders.name: Nick Perry
founders.background_notes: Led healthcare work at Palantir per Fortune.

founders.name: Doug Proctor
founders.background_notes: Built defense and intelligence systems at Palantir per Fortune. A profile says he and Perry spent five years at Palantir.

founders.name: Adam Reis
founders.background_notes: Named as third co-founder in one profile only; YC page lists only Nick Perry.

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed clearinghouse and payer connectivity, claim rules across many payers, and EMR integrations, all heavy for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and claim history compound, and billing is mission critical, but rivals such as Waystar and Akasa sell similar automation.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; sources only describe these firms as rivals, with Candid positioned for digital health companies they underserved.

market_need_then: Billing insurance is a large and painful cost, Fortune frames US medical billing as a roughly 280 billion dollar problem, and fast growing digital health companies needed billing built into software.

branding.domain_note: Uses joincandidhealth.com; candid.org belongs to an unrelated nonprofit.

identity.logo: Rebranded August 2025 with a Venn diagram style icon for finance and healthcare
identity.visual_style: Modern identity with a graphic device called The Arch, per an agency case study
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident: Make billing insurance our problem. Not yours.

branding.brand_signature: Make billing insurance our problem. Not yours.

rebrands.why: Sharper expression of the company as it grew; name unchanged

brand_strength.rationale: Clear tagline and a brand relaunch with agency work, but the name is a common word shared with a nonprofit and no community or merch evidence was found.

outcome_analysis: Candid started in 2019 from two Palantir veterans and built an API first billing platform for digital health. After YC in Winter 2020 it raised a 29M Series B in September 2024, 52.5M in February 2025 and 120M in July 2026, with the company reporting ARR growth near 190 percent and over 200 customers. Early rounds, including a possible Series A, are not confirmed, and valuations are not stated.
notes: Series C seen in Pulse 2.0 and a Lowenstein release. Series B seen in an aggregator and referenced in Pulse 2.0 style coverage, treated as likely. A 16M Series A in May 2022 appears only in aggregator Persana and a 2M Series A only in ZoomInfo, so neither is recorded. Total raised over 219M per Fortune implies about 17M of earlier funding not itemized. Competition list is empty because only undated aggregator pages named rivals (Waystar, Change Healthcare, athenahealth, Akasa); nothing dated near early 2020 was found. Founder list conflicts across sources; YC lists Nick Perry only. Fetch of mobihealthnews returned 403 and was not worked around.
